output.reason: [ev-816adf94e987] says the Helm hook migrates resources automatically, so only upgrades done without Helm or without the hook need manual migration. The proposed condition flags every environment with v2alpha1 objects, including Helm-hook upgrades that are not exposed, so it is too broad. Its gvk-in-use leaves only detect v2alpha1 manifests. Applying those would be a separate rejection, not this migration of stored objects. The rendered diffs show v2alpha1 removed from three CRDs [ev-d4e66123c4de][ev-9fdd5d1096ef][ev-b8120a2bb840], but the list of affected CRDs is cut off, and neither the upgrade path nor what is stored is visible statically, so exposure is undecidable.

correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13 drops deprecated API versions of its managed CRDs (rendered diffs show kyverno.io/v2alpha1 removed from CleanupPolicy, ClusterCleanupPolicy and PolicyException). The Helm hook migrates stored resources automatically; installs upgraded without Helm or without the hook must migrate existing resources, e.g. via kube-storage-version-migrator.

exposure.needed: whether Kyverno is upgraded without Helm or with the Helm migration hook disabled, and whether existing Kyverno custom resources (e.g. CleanupPolicy, ClusterCleanupPolicy, PolicyException) are still stored at a dropped deprecated API version such as kyverno.io/v2alpha1
